correctness.rationale: The signed-binary bijection gives a one-to-one parameterization of unordered partitions by positive odd r with pr<=2^(a+1)-1. Endpoint algebra, prime-distribution consequences, and the omega double count were checked; exact bounded computation found zero mismatches.

originality.rationale: Known sources cover existence and the k=1 interval, but current OEIS entries, Rao--Peng, Mahanta--Saikia--Yaqubi, synonymous searches, and the SCOPE archive did not reveal the arbitrary-k formula, limiting law, or aggregate omega identity. Residual informal-literature risks are stated. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The result quantitatively refines the full exponent-one two-prime Zumkeller family, resolves every fixed partition multiplicity, and derives both a universal prime-parameter distribution and an additive-function aggregate law.
